source.label: Datadog — expanded AWS strategic collaboration, December 3, 2025

source.quote: DDOG), the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications, today at AWS re:Invent announced a new strategic collaboration agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and showcased multiple product launches across AI, observability and security to help organizations running on AWS monitor, optimize and secure their cloud environments.
